title: tui: keys that act on the selected issue
body: claim, unclaim, close with a reason, and note on single keys, through the functions from the mutations refactor. A write re-reads the snapshot afterwards, since another clone or agent may have moved the ref.
close_reason: m/u/n/x/X act through ops with a footer prompt; the helper is tested against a temporary repository

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6de6737a
notes.text: Reverted after use: m/u/n/x/X on single unmodified keys did more harm than good, since a slip while moving writes to the shared ref. Jack's call. ops.rs stays. Any future writes from the screen need a deliberate entry, a command line or a confirmation, not a bare key.
